QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Destonen the Pioneer
QuestInfo.0: The pioneer is certainly #bDestonen#k. He said he's headed to #bBeyond the Cave#k. Hurry and meet him.
QuestInfo.1: The pioneer is certainly #bDestonen#k. He said he's headed to #bBeyond the Cave#k. Hurry and meet him.
QuestInfo.2:
You went to Beyond the Cave to find Destonen and saw him enter a suspicious tent. According to the <Chronicles of Ellin Forest>, that place was Kirston's Research Lab.
Destonen stopped his steps when you told him that he will meet his death after finding out a dangerous truth.
When you told him you're from the future, he asked about his grown daughter he might not be able to see since he's human. You told him that she's living freely on the seas like he had.

default.0: Go to #bBeyond the Cave#k. #bDestonen#k should be there.
